audit_items.proof_trace: The index() function silently discards duplicate epoch entries (line 523: if _, ok := ns.byEpoch[e.Epoch]; !ok). When BlobSchedule contains duplicate epochs, only the first occurrence is indexed in byEpoch map, while MaxBlobsPerBlock iterates the sorted array and finds the last. This creates non-deterministic behavior depending on which lookup path is used.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker crafts malicious chain config YAML with duplicate BlobSchedule epochs (e.g., [{Epoch:12, MaxBlobsPerBlock:6}, {Epoch:12, MaxBlobsPerBlock:999}]). Different code paths return different values: networkSchedule.byEpoch[12] returns 6, but MaxBlobsPerBlock(epoch 12) returns 999. This causes consensus splits between nodes using different lookup methods.
